items.title: Sarma escalates counter-front: ready for ballot-paper polls if Congress govts resign; demands SIR every 5 years; BJP Assam rallies till Oct 31
items.summary: Assam CM Himanta Biswa Sarma at a Monday press conference in Guwahati said he is ready to contest elections via ballot paper if Rahul Gandhi gets Congress governments in Kerala, Karnataka and Telangana to resign, claiming they were formed via 'vote chori' under CEC Gyanesh Kumar; demanded Gandhi resign first since he was elected through the same process. He defended the SIR as essential to check demographic change and demanded it every five years, and announced BJP Assam will hold peaceful mass rallies at every district headquarters until Oct 31 in support of constitutional institutions. Extends his earlier alerted 'resign your governments / boycott elections' challenge with new specifics.
